faqs: Can we use our own graphics and logo?
Yes. Submit your artwork, logo placement and color references for review. Final artwork, permissions and print placement must be approved before sampling.
Is this a 220 GSM rash guard?
This product uses a nominal 240 GSM development brief with an 85% polyester / 15% spandex blend. Confirm the actual selected fabric and its tolerance during sampling.
Does the extended hem include silicone?
The brief specifies an extended, contoured torso. A silicone gripper is not confirmed for this reference; specify it separately if required.
How do we approve fit and print quality?
Approve a measurement chart, size allocation, stretch and recovery, seam comfort, artwork alignment and wash-test requirements. Keep a signed sample and specification for repeat orders.
